old_reward.objective: Reference: minimize accumulated entity delay; not an optimized reward
old_reward.approval_basis: User authorized controlled simulator learning. Unit total-delay objective retained; no TEST-derived weights. Safety/fairness remain external evaluation gates. This review authorizes a synthetic experiment, not road deployment.

confirmed_limitations: 12 short training episodes/run, no convergence evidence
Original actor lacks explicit static geometry features
Reward only total delay; other costs had zero weight
Higher learned shield intervention rate; includes normal clearance locks, not physical violations
Feature/noise ablations statistically inconclusive; do not claim causal benefit
hypotheses: Insufficient sample budget and shield action aliasing may hamper learning; not established causal findings
new_controlled_changes: 13 scenario profiles with separate realization seeds
